title: Netflix execs and industry insiders say co-CEO Ted Sarandos devised its mass-market and international growth strategy, which the now-fired Bela Bajaria executed (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Netflix execs and industry insiders say co-CEO Ted Sarandos devised its mass-market and international growth strategy, which the now-fired Bela Bajaria executed — Co-chief Ted Sarandos faces questions over content strategy as slowing viewer engagement threatens growth
